_NOTE: NOT DEPLOYED. Vercel reads the ROOT vercel.json only; a nested one is ignored. Leftover from when OSA was its own repository. The headers it asks for (X-Frame-Options DENY, no-cache) are NOT in effect — the root vercel.json sets X-Frame-Options SAMEORIGIN for every path. If OSA genuinely needs DENY, add a path rule for /tenants/osa there.
